historical_context.time_period: Pre-imperial Airawa era, before the Biological Memetic Engine
historical_context.location: A shared pollen terrace at the root-and-canopy boundary of two neighboring Matriarch networks on the Airawa home continent.
historical_context.summary: A routine pollen-tithe morning becomes a public hearing when the local Matriarch diverts threadwing, lantern, and fungal traffic from a rival canopy, then offers one Airawa household gestation priority in return for certifying the rival's default.

public_facts.text: Matriarch Trees preserve Airawa communal memory and gestate Airawa young through contracts involving compatible gametes and pollinator species.
Threadwings carry pollen, gut symbionts, route reports, and social injuries, and may withhold service or carry grievances when partners break terms.
Lantern trees and candle fungal roads exchange sugars, minerals, warnings, and traffic; either can reroute or starve an abusive partner.
Pre-imperial Airawa contract dress makes ecological obligations, protection, debt, invitation, and refusal publicly legible.

ambient_pressures.text: Eclipse ingress compresses the safe light window for courier launch and makes lantern-route access materially scarce.
The local household wants a place in the next gestation window but depends on couriers and routes the Matriarch cannot command alone.
Evidence is local and saleable: lattice ants can distinguish residues and disclose findings, but only within the physical history their temporary circuit can read.

groups.label: Local Matriarch compact
institutional_logic: Preserve local archive and gestation priority by controlling the coalition of traffic, light, minerals, labor, and testimony around the canopy.
material_incentives: Gain a disputed eclipse crossing, obtain one rival ancestry copy, keep compatible gametes arriving, and prevent local route partners from defecting.
internal_shames: Gestation promises no partner can fulfill
prestige_markers: Household seals gathered beneath the buttress
taboo_triggers: A household protecting a rival claim
Road or lantern partners publicly refusing the Matriarch's account
emotional_display_norms: Approval and displeasure appear as warmth, pressure, sap movement, route subsidies, archive access, and delayed privileges rather than facial performance.
trust_defaults: Trusts partners who remain materially dependent and publicly legible; underestimates the willingness of mobile parties to leave.

groups.label: Rival Matriarch network
institutional_logic: Keep its archive boundaries and crossing claim while preserving enough pollination, gamete traffic, and minerals to survive the reproductive window.
material_incentives: Reopen the courier and mineral corridor without surrendering ancestry memory or the disputed crossing.
internal_virtues: Refusal to trade ancestry under starvation pressure
internal_shames: A crossing surrendered under ecological siege
A grievance with no recognized custodian
prestige_markers: Couriers willing to bypass hostile lights
A corridor kept open by outside constituencies
taboo_triggers: The local diversion being described as weather or unpaid debt
emotional_display_norms: The distant canopy is present through courier cargo, root residue, route closure, and the terms its partners carry.
trust_defaults: Trusts mobile witnesses and material corridors more than local Matriarch assurances.

groups.label: Threadwing route colony
institutional_logic: Keep cargo viable, nesting routes safe, and payment reliable while preserving the right to refuse manipulative partners.
material_incentives: Salt, nectar, clean roosts, parasite grooming, reliable light, and a route reputation other ecologies will honor.
internal_shames: Letting a canopy speak as if it owns the carriers
emotional_display_norms: Trust and offense appear through landing distance, vane spread, cargo custody, flock silence, and route choice.
trust_defaults: Trusts clean payment and accurate route signals, but keeps individual and colony grudges alive.

groups.label: Airawa households using the shared terrace
institutional_logic: Keep children, ancestry, food plants, and eclipse routes viable without becoming disposable extensions of one Matriarch's rivalry.
material_incentives: Gestation priority, archive continuity, safe climbing work, salt access, reliable pollination, and retaliation shared widely enough to survive.
internal_shames: A seal promising resources the household cannot supply
Private safety purchased by breaking the food web
prestige_markers: Multiple household markers facing outward together
taboo_triggers: A Matriarch treating household labor as automatic obedience
emotional_display_norms: Fear and dissent are made public through seal placement, ribbon custody, climbing position, light exposure, and whether a household marker faces inward or outward.
trust_defaults: Trusts visible reciprocal contracts while fearing the Matriarch's ability to delay memory and reproduction.

groups.label: Lantern, fungal-road, and lattice-ant route partners
institutional_logic: Keep light, traffic, recycling, and testimony valuable enough that no single archive can consume the system that sustains them.
material_incentives: Sugar, clean waste, minerals, traffic, sugar payment, protected fruiting bodies, and credible public questions.
internal_shames: A route starved by its own sanction
A diagnosis sold as certainty beyond its local evidence
prestige_markers: An ant glyph that survives public inspection
taboo_triggers: Forced monopoly over reports or routes
emotional_display_norms: The coalition has no shared face; posture is distributed across light, bead spacing, ant geometry, opened lanes, and withheld service.
trust_defaults: Cooperates where accounts meet, but each partner may defect separately when its appetite or risk is ignored.

cultural_pressure_fields.summary: Gestation access gives the Matriarch real bargaining power, but successful reproduction still depends on autonomous carriers, routes, and household work.
cultural_pressure_fields.projection_use: Keep every promise of gestation priority materially tied to courier, light, road, and household cooperation.

cultural_pressure_fields.summary: Threadwings take payment and obligations seriously while refusing the fiction that accepting a tithe transfers ownership of the route.
cultural_pressure_fields.projection_use: Show trust through landing, eating, cargo custody, and route choice; show defection through distance, silence, and grievance carriage.

cultural_pressure_fields.summary: Road, lantern, and diagnostic partners profit from viable traffic and credible signals, so a Matriarch's total blockade can destroy the coalition she needs.
cultural_pressure_fields.projection_use: Let route partners preserve minimum flows or abandon a patron when sanction threatens their own food, credit, or credibility.

observer_read: A carrier organ expected to honor local gestation priority
target_self_read: A route-owning colony whose cargo, nests, and grievances remain its own
misread_patterns: The Matriarch confuses dependence on light and salt with obedience
The couriers may treat every local delay as intentional coercion
factional_misread_matrix.projection_use: Make the coalition fracture visible when the Matriarch promises gestation outcomes without maintaining courier consent.

observer_read: An ancestor, gestator, archive, and dangerous patron whose displeasure can reach unborn futures
target_self_read: The continuity organ coordinating debts that short-lived households cannot see whole
misread_patterns: Households may personalize distributed root pressure
The Matriarch may classify dissent as failure to understand long-term continuity
factional_misread_matrix.projection_use: Keep the tender's fear concrete in gestation markers, root support, archive access, and household seals rather than abstract anti-tree ideology.

observer_read: Infrastructure receiving subsidies from the archive polity
target_self_read: Independent organisms selling light, recycling, evidence, and passage under revocable contracts
misread_patterns: The Matriarch may assume local sugar or shelter buys coalition unity
Route partners may underestimate how precisely the Matriarch can retaliate against their Airawa supporters
factional_misread_matrix.projection_use: Use different visible signals for each party's independent consent and let private offers divide an underfunded coalition.

role_pressure_fields.summary: An Airawa household representative performing precise terrace work while deciding which ecological account their public seal will support.
failure_modes: Buying safety that destroys the route

role_pressure_fields.summary: An experienced Airawa witness who translates coalition pressure and protects the household without pretending neutrality is free.
obligations: Name costs without usurping the household seal
failure_modes: Protecting one household by normalizing ecological siege

role_pressure_fields.summary: A familiar threadwing courier carrying colony memory, rival grievance, and gamete-cargo risk without becoming any Matriarch's messenger property.
obligations: Carry grievances accurately enough to change terms
failure_modes: Letting cargo cool during a hearing
Accepting payment that destroys route reputation
Turning one individual grudge into false colony policy

known_context.text: The tender knows the terrace's public accounts, route geometry, household resources, local gestation petition, and readable ecological signals.

beliefs.text: The tender believes a household seal can make ecological coercion more expensive when other constituencies can inspect and support it.

misreads.text: The tender may overestimate how much a true public diagnosis can constrain a Matriarch whose archive and gestation leverage remain intact.

must_not_know.text: The tender must not know either Matriarch's private archive state, hidden gestation capacity, or future imperial rupture.

known_context.text: The elder knows local coalition customs, the household's petition, and how contract dress, route light, and food offerings alter public standing.

beliefs.text: The elder believes every ecological victory creates an account someone will later collect.

misreads.text: The elder may mistake accumulated caution for an adequate substitute for organized household support.

must_not_know.text: The elder must not infer the rival Matriarch's private motive beyond the grievance and route evidence presented on the terrace.

known_context.text: The broker knows the routes personally flown, cargo condition, nest and colony obligations, payments tasted, light seen, and residue carried.

beliefs.text: The broker treats safe light and clean payment as route terms, not proof that a Matriarch owns the courier colony.

misreads.text: The broker may attribute a distributed route failure to intentional Matriarch policy before local diagnostics separate the causes.

must_not_know.text: The broker must not know household deliberation or root-archive intent that has not become visible through speech, markers, temperature, pressure, or route change.

author_only_boundaries.text: The Biological Memetic Engine will later convert negotiated tree networks into imperial transmission infrastructure, but no participant in this pre-imperial fixture treats that future as known.
Functional English handles such as shared pollen terrace, scar-vane broker, and pollen tithe are translations for this fixture, not Weksa-language canon names.

open_questions.question: What Weksa terms distinguish pollination payment, gamete carriage, route subsidy, and coercive diversion?
open_questions.notes: Naming remains reserved to later Weksa work; this fixture uses explicit translated functional handles.

open_questions.question: How are gestation windows measured and publicly queued across different Matriarch polities?
open_questions.notes: The fixture uses only relative priority and a visible warm or dark marker, avoiding a universal calendar or queue mechanism.
